purpose: A fresh archival test whose source, observable family and test algorithm precede archive selection and outcome-summary disclosure.
source_family: XZ-plane maximal Bell correlations; psi+ is the proven right-color-Z operation on the original source
eligible_archives: Official public two-party Bell data with either outcome-independent event-ready heralding or deterministic trial preparation, a documented maximally entangled real Bell preparation, two documented XZ measurement settings per arm, per-event settings/outcomes or readout times, and complete outcome recording under outcome-independent event selection.
custodian_selection: Non-theory custodian selects on preparation, metadata completeness, public access and manageable size; no selection by CHSH, wins, p-values or agreement with the source. If several qualify, use the smallest complete download, then lexicographic DOI as tie-breaker.
disclosure_to_theory: Only source identity, controlled preparation/axes, column meanings, pre-outcome selection and independently measured disjoint calibration. Keep evaluation outcomes, sample counts, CHSH, wins and fitted test-state summaries sealed until final instrument table/parser commitment.
sample_policy: All designated Bell-test trials in documented acquisition order, up to the first 100000 accepted trials. Exclude key-only settings by the documented protocol; do not select outcomes, windows or stopping points from test results.
alternatives: The unchanged six visibility components plus prior-only KT, fixed equal weights and mixture of products
radius_role: Conditional per-cell sensitivity at each point-model alpha, not an inferred calibration confidence region
calibration_policy: Optional fixed depolarization then independent asymmetric F0/F1 assignment, only with documented calibration disjoint from evaluation events; never infer these parameters from target CHSH or target event counts.
failure_policy: A candidate lacking the required preparation, axes or parser semantics receives an explicit eligibility disposition. Missing disjoint calibration omits the optional calibrated model, not the archive. No outcome-based repair or silent replacement. Retain all candidate-selection records.
prior_development_data: Delft 2016 and its summaries are L0 development material for the already fixed method; they are excluded from this new evaluation stream.
prior_disposition: No directly accessible, fully documented event-ready event stream was recovered from the recorded official candidates. Preserve the custodian selection record; this is not a claim that those data do not exist.
revision_basis: The certified herald_probability theorem uses plus as a preparation operation and does not assume a random event-ready trigger. Deterministically prepared real Bell trials with complete outcome recording consume the identical fixed family. This eligibility expansion follows the theorem and access/metadata record, without disclosure of any new experimental counts or results to the theory role.
